journey.title: Engage. Convert. Support. Bring customers back.
paragraphs: From the first message to the next purchase, give customers help and keep your team in control.

stages.label: Engage
stages.title: Start conversations with the right customers.
paragraphs: Send an offer on WhatsApp, reply to an Instagram comment or run an ad that opens a chat. Your AI agent can answer when people respond.

items.title: Send personalised WhatsApp campaigns
paragraphs: Choose your customer list, add names and offers, and schedule your message. See the estimated messaging cost before you send.

items.title: Turn Instagram comments into DMs
paragraphs: Send a message when someone comments with a word like PRICE or LINK. Reply to story responses and mentions with a flow you choose.

items.title: Run ads that open a WhatsApp chat
paragraphs: Create click-to-WhatsApp ads and track their performance. Use a flow to ask questions and save details when someone messages you.

items.title: Manage Instagram comments
paragraphs: Let AI reply to questions in comments. Your team can also view, reply to and manage comments from the dashboard.

stages.label: Convert
stages.title: Help interested customers buy or book.
paragraphs: Answer what they want to know, find out what they need and help them take action in the chat.

items.title: Help shoppers choose and order
paragraphs: Show products from your connected catalogue, recommend suitable options, add items to a cart and share a checkout link in WhatsApp or Instagram.

“StepsAI is good at the questions that don’t fit neatly into filters. People will say what they need, their budget, maybe what they’ve bought before, and StepsAI can point them to a few products that actually make sense.”
Anika Rao | Head of Digital | Mysa Living

items.title: Collect useful lead details
paragraphs: Ask for a name, contact details, budget or other information you need. Save the answers in your built-in CRM so your team can follow up.
“Now StepsAI gets the details while they’re already talking and passes the lead into our CRM with the conversation attached.”
Ryan Collins | Growth Lead | Northstar SaaS

items.title: Book appointments and demos
paragraphs: Connect your calendar so customers can choose an available time during the conversation.

items.title: Send important enquiries to your team
paragraphs: Use the answers customers give to decide what happens next. Bring in a person when an enquiry needs their attention.

stages.label: Support
stages.title: Keep helping customers when they need you.
paragraphs: Answer everyday questions, share order updates and pass conversations to your team when a person is needed.

items.title: Answer from your own information
paragraphs: Give the agent your website, FAQs and documents. It uses that information to answer questions about products, services and policies.

items.title: Share order and delivery updates
paragraphs: Connect your store and supported delivery tools so customers can ask about their orders in the chat.
“The order-status questions have almost disappeared from our support queue.”
Maya Patel | Head of E-commerce | North & Pine

items.title: Create tickets for requests
paragraphs: Save the question and customer details, create a ticket and notify the people who need to handle it.

items.title: Reply when you miss a WhatsApp call
paragraphs: Send an automatic message when a customer calls and you cannot answer. Let them continue the conversation in chat.

stages.label: Bring customers back
stages.title: Follow up after the conversation ends.
paragraphs: Set up messages for unfinished purchases, customer updates and repeat orders. Choose the timing and what happens when someone replies.

items.title: Recover abandoned Shopify checkouts
paragraphs: Send a WhatsApp reminder when a shopper leaves before buying. Your AI agent can answer questions that come back.

items.title: Confirm cash-on-delivery orders
paragraphs: Ask Shopify customers to confirm their COD order on WhatsApp before your team ships it.

items.title: Welcome customers and ask for reviews
paragraphs: Use workflow templates to send welcome messages, order updates and review requests.

items.title: Give customers a reason to return
paragraphs: Send relevant offers and new-product updates to selected WhatsApp audiences.

team.title: See the conversations, customers and results in one place.
paragraphs: Your agent handles the routine work. Your team can see what happened and take over when needed.

items.title: One inbox for your customer messages
paragraphs: View website, WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger conversations together. Filter by channel or label, and assign conversations to your team.

items.title: Customer details saved as you talk
paragraphs: Keep contact details, tickets and requests in the built-in CRM. Add the fields your business needs and group contacts for follow-up.

items.title: Human help with the conversation included
paragraphs: Your team can read the chat before taking over. On Instagram, replying from the app pauses the AI so it does not talk over you.

items.title: Know what customers ask and what works
paragraphs: See common questions, response times, leads and campaign results. For Shopify on WhatsApp, track orders and revenue from conversations and campaigns.

setup.title: Set it up for the way your business works.
paragraphs: Add your information, connect your tools and choose the jobs you want to automate. No coding needed.

items.title: Add your business information
paragraphs: Start with your website, FAQs or documents. Reuse shared information across your agents so updates are easier to manage.

items.title: Choose how your agent talks and acts
paragraphs: Set its name, tone and instructions. Decide which questions it can handle and when it should call in your team.

items.title: Build the follow-up you need
paragraphs: Start with a template or connect steps in the visual builder. Ask questions, save answers, wait, send messages and choose different paths based on a reply.

items.title: Test it before customers use it
paragraphs: Preview answers and run test conversations. Check your workflows before switching them on.

items.title: Connect the tools you already use
paragraphs: Connect your store, calendar, CRM and knowledge sources to help your agent do the job.
Shopify | WooCommerce | Google Calendar | Calendly | HubSpot | Zendesk | Google Drive | Notion

faq.title: A few answers before you book a demo.

items.title: Is Steps AI only for online stores?
paragraphs: No. You can use it for enquiries, appointments, lead capture and customer support across different businesses. Store integrations add product, checkout and order features for ecommerce.

items.title: Can it do more than reply to messages?
paragraphs: Yes. It can collect lead details, book appointments and create tickets. The platform also lets you run campaigns and build workflows for follow-up and other tasks.

items.title: How does it know about my business?
paragraphs: You add your website, FAQs and documents, then connect the tools it needs. The agent uses your information and instructions when it replies.

items.title: Can my team take over?
paragraphs: Yes. Your team can take over with the conversation history available. You can also set rules for when the agent should ask for human help.

items.title: Do all features work on every channel?
paragraphs: No. WhatsApp supports broadcasts, Shopify cart recovery and COD confirmation. Instagram supports comment-to-DM and story triggers. Your demo will show what works on the channels you use.

items.title: Do I need a developer?
paragraphs: You can set up your agent and build workflows without coding. The setup depends on the jobs, channels and tools you want to connect.
